fact: In March 2025 the Bamako Forum on Digital and Social Cohesion published a report on digital regulation in the Sahel, co-authored by a researcher of the Faculty of Public Law at the University of Legal and Political Sciences of Bamako, mapping the legal frameworks of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.
title: Régulation du numérique au Sahel : État des lieux et perspectives pour un modèle centré sur l'humain
publisher: Search for Common Ground / Forum de Bamako sur le numérique et la cohésion sociale
